newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moody's says may downgrade three Taiwan banks.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says may downgrade three Taiwan banks.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it has placed under review for possible downgrade the ratings of three Taiwan banks.
Moody's said it may cut the A2 long-term and Prime-1 short-term ratings of Chang Hwa Commercial Bank, First Commercial Bank and Hua Nan Commercial Bank.
Moody's also said it may cut the three banks' Bank Financial Strength Ratings of "C."
Moody's said that the action was due to continued deterioration in the banks' asset quality and their relatively weak financial fundamentals.

The rating agency noted that the increase in problem loans was due to the prolonged weakness in the Taiwan real estate market and the general slowdown of the economy. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843-6371
